Independent computational research · VARZIN Project

Finite systems.
Open questions.

A research program at the intersection of finite affine mathematics, reproducible computation, and constructed symbolic systems.

Led by Reza Nirouyar. Built around explicit assumptions, controlled tests, and a record that remains open to correction.

01 / Reading the evidence

Different claims.
Different standards of evidence.

A mathematical proof, a computational report and an empirical question are distinct research records. Each should be read within its stated scope.

Proved mathematics

Affine bijection criterion; valid multiplier count.

Reproducible computation

Deterministic implementations; verify the specific release.

Project-reported

Computational findings with stated artifact limits.

Conditional

Mirror-13 MDL depends on its coding and candidate space.

Exploratory

Designed structure and hypotheses requiring controls.

Negative

Tested criteria or predicted recovery not achieved.

Open questions

Independent semantics remain unestablished.

Planned research

Human evaluation; no established outcome.

Historical / superseded

Earlier claims retained for provenance.

No established evidence for physical or consciousness-field effects, quantum mechanisms, frequency-to-meaning causation, or independent semantic emergence. Read the current research position ↗

02 / Research directions

A focused research program.

View the complete atlas ↗
A / MATHEMATICS

Finite affine systems

Affine permutations over finite cyclic spaces, deterministic models and construction-specific audits.

|Aff(ℤN)| = Nφ(N)

The bijection criterion is proved mathematics. Mirror-13 connectivity checks are a separate computational record.

Read the finite affine systems guide ↗
B / SYMBOLIC STRUCTURE

LUXVAR

A constructed symbolic system with deliberately designed morphemic and structural regularities.

Core-30 / public registry

The broader 801-entry design layer is not 801 equally validated roots. Surface structure does not establish independent semantics.

Understand LUXVAR ↗
C / OPEN EMPIRICAL QUESTIONS

Controlled evaluation

Protocols for separating intended semantic structure from morphology, matched controls and training effects.

Planned / human evaluation

Recruitment has not commenced for the later N=59 plan. No human outcome is established; protocol identities remain unresolved.

Read protocol history & limits ↗
AI structure-auditing guide ↗

05 / Negative results

What the tests did not establish.

Negative results constrain the next question. They remain visible alongside positive findings.

Negative · tested frozen models

Semantic-axis recovery

Track D reported ARI −0.0337 for Mistral 7B and +0.0152 for Llama 3 8B against intended axis/orbit labels. This finding applies to those unremediated models and that protocol.

Read Track D scope ↗
Negative · tested composition

Unseen-pair generalization

Project-reported trained representation recovery did not yield systematic held-out composition in the tested procedure. This is not a claim about all LLM algebra.

Read composition & artifact limits ↗
Criterion not met

Semantic evidence

SEM-001 found no string-level semantic-axis signal in the tested analysis. SEM-002 met 1 of 4 criteria against a threshold of at least 2 of 4.

Read the preprint record ↗

06 / Provenance & corrections

A research record
that can be questioned.

Earlier interpretations remain traceable. Corrections change the reading of the evidence; historical documents do not override the current position.

Inspect the access-action register ↗
  1. 01

    Clustering interpretation corrected

    Historical ARI 0.812 concerns inter-model surface/morpheme agreement, not intended semantic-axis recovery. Raw pairwise scoring was not independently reverified at correction.

  2. 02

    Version identities remain explicit

    The 20691858 / 22115483 deposit-version mapping and YEGJ8 / 2NKZA protocol relationship remain partially unresolved.

  3. 03

    Historical material stays accessible

    Earlier symbolic narratives, historical reports and the previous portal are preserved as provenance, not current findings.
